summary: Ran 27 pytest backend tests + smoke UI tests. 27/27 backend pass after fixing one ObjectId-serialization bug in POST /api/withdrawals. Discovered a CRITICAL wallet accounting bug: when admin marks a withdrawal as 'paid', the balance is debited twice (once via total_withdrawn and once via a newly-inserted debit txn). Frontend admin+customer flows (signup+OTP verify, login, dashboard, campaigns, categories, customers, withdrawals page, profile/KYC, statements) all load and integrate correctly.

critical.issue: Double-counting: compute_wallet sums 'paid' withdrawals into total_withdrawn AND the mark-paid handler also inserts a debit transaction (ref_id WD-*), so balance drops by 2x the withdrawal amount. Fix option A: do NOT insert debit txn on paid (rely on total_withdrawn). Fix option B: remove total_withdrawn from balance formula and rely only on debit txns. Admin dashboard's total_wallet_balance formula already tries to avoid this by filtering ref_id.startswith('WD'), which confirms the inconsistency between the two computations.

minor.issue: FIXED by testing agent: response dict included Mongo ObjectId `_id` (from insert_one mutation) causing 500 Internal Server Error on serialization. Changed to filter out `_id` key.

Review request mentions this slug but it is not in the seeded demo campaigns (only angel-one-demat, zerodha-account, hdfc-tata-neu-credit-card, au-small-finance-savings-a-c, sbi-simplyclick-card, term-life-insurance). Tested with an actual seeded slug instead — endpoint works. Consider seeding a 'Radhika Connect' campaign if it is expected.
@app.on_event('startup') is deprecated in FastAPI; use lifespan. Not blocking.

insert_one mutates the input dict adding `_id` (ObjectId); several handlers return that dict directly. Only POST /api/withdrawals hit the bug (now fixed); audit similar patterns elsewhere if new handlers are added.

No rate limiting / brute-force protection on /auth/login and /auth/register (spec mentioned 5-fail lockout for auth playbook).

rca_of_the_issue: Wallet double-debit RCA: In server.py, compute_wallet() (lines 494-508) computes balance = credited - debited - total_withdrawn - pending. Meanwhile update_withdrawal() at line 566-571 inserts a debit transaction when status='paid'. This causes the paid amount to be subtracted twice: once via total_withdrawn and once via total_debited. Reproduction: (1) admin credits customer Rs.500, (2) customer requests Rs.200 withdrawal after KYC, (3) admin marks paid, (4) GET /api/wallet returns balance=100 instead of expected 300. Mitigation: remove the debit-txn insert in the paid handler (preferred, since admin_dashboard already treats WD-prefixed debits specially) OR drop total_withdrawn from compute_wallet's balance formula.
